subject: Cadet Civil Engineer (SEEK 95367897), Marc Masarate

letter.company_line: Coolamon Shire Council is offering a Cadet Civil Engineer role in its Engineering and Technical Services team from January 2027, covering surveying, design, construction, project management and maintenance of Council infrastructure.
letter.subject: Cadet Civil Engineer, Coolamon Shire Council (SEEK 95367897)
letter.greeting: Hello Engineering and Technical Services team,
paragraphs: I saw your Cadet Civil Engineer advert on SEEK. Your note that Council is open to supporting study at Diploma, Associate Degree or Degree level is why I am applying.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute, designing and documenting road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD to Australian Standards. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and as a field engineer on residential subdivision finishing works, carrying out inspections and quality checks and keeping site reports and material records.

The mix of design, construction and maintenance of Council roads and drainage in your cadetship is the practical grounding I want. I hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am based in Melton VIC and open to discussing relocation to the Riverina.
I have attached my resume and would be glad to talk about whether my qualifications suit the cadetship.

screening_answers.question: Which of the following statements best describes your right to work in Australia?
screening_answers.answer: I have a temporary visa with full working rights (Subclass 485, valid to December 2027).

screening_answers.question: How many years' experience do you have as a civil engineer?
screening_answers.answer: Under 1 year (field engineer and project-in-charge, Philippines, April 2019 to February 2020).

screening_answers.question: How much notice are you required to give your current employer?
screening_answers.answer: MARC TO ANSWER (no notice period on record).

screening_answers.question: How many years' experience do you have in construction law?

checklist: Resolve the hold first: ask Council whether an applicant who already holds a civil degree and Advanced Diploma and is not currently enrolled is eligible for the cadetship
Marc to confirm a NSW Class C licence (transfer on relocation) and that he would move to the Riverina
Marc to decide how to handle a January 2027 cadetship start against 485 work rights ending December 2027
Only then apply on SEEK with the resume and saved cover letter
